title: Menus: Build the Navigation of Your Site | Orchard Core
description:
Visitors find their way around a site with its menus, and the people who manage the site need to change them without touching a theme.

The Orchard Core Menu module stores each menu as a content item with a title, an alias and a tree of menu items. You add items, arrange them by dragging, and publish the menu to change what visitors see.

In this video:
• Menus and menu items: what a menu is made of
• Open a menu: find a menu and its items
• Add a menu item: a link at the first level
• Nest and reorder: build the tree and set the order
• Publish a menu: make the changes visible
• Create a menu: a second menu for the site
